Joke names: 'Luke With Gilette Razor Blades' dested Luke With Lightsaber; 'Luke Skywalker, Ugliest Jedi Knight' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Obi And his Walking Stick' Obi-Wan With Lightsaber (x3 as posted); 'Courage of a gaywalker' Courage Of A Skywalker; 'Yodas Slum' / 'Chief Chirpas Slum' Dagobah: Yoda's Hut / Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut; 'Ma$$a$$i' sites the Yavin 4: Massassi sites.

Posted 'Chewie With Gun' dested Chewie With Blaster Rifle (Enhanced Cloud City); 'Leia And Gun' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Han And Gun' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Twass Khaa' Tawss Khaa; 'Hoth War Room' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'Fall of a Legend' Fall Of The Legend; Battle Plan is the Endor Effect (not the Reflections III shield).
